units.source_text: 我无法说清这种笑从何而来。

en.t: I could not explain where this smile came from.

units.source_text: 这种笑似乎是从外部来，突然贴在我的嘴边。

en.t: This smile seemed to come from outside me, suddenly attaching itself to the corners of my mouth.

units.source_text: 老师看见我的笑，顿时脸色都变了。

en.t: When the teacher saw my smile, his expression changed at once.
